messages:
nina: Kickoff: creating RC artifact gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026-04-01-rc1. Need quick checks on feature flags, rollback rules, and quiet window 23:00-01:00 UTC.

pete: Quick glance at changelog looks fine. What's the rollback criteria?

raj: Suggest: immediate revert to inference:2026.03.30-prod if p95 >+15% OR error-rate >0.6% sustained 5m. Also abort if canary doesn't stabilize in 45m (deadman).

nina: Agree on numbers. Flag `rc_enable_sched_v2` default=false. No DB migration during promo.

deploy-bot: Deploy request received: artifact=gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026-04-01-rc1, window=2026-04-02T23:00Z..2026-04-03T01:00Z, plan=kv-warm->smoke->canary(5%->30%->100%). Pin will be applied after signoff.

pete: CI green and image scanned. +1 from me.

docs-bot: Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/2026-04-01-rc1 (includes flag guidance and rollback snippet).

nina: Pinning now. Oncall @sre-rotation please watch p95, 5xx, queue depth.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026-04-01-rc1 -> refs/rc-pins/2026-04-01 by nina.

raj: Starting kv-warm and smoke at 23:05 UTC.

sre-rotation: Watching dashboards. Alert thresholds configured per rollback numbers.

deploy-bot: Canary 5% -> gcr.io/redwood/inference:2026-04-01-rc1. Initial smoke OK.

pete: Running quick load test: p95 +3%, 5xx 0.02%. good to ramp.

nina: Ramp to 30% at 23:25 UTC.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 30%. Extended smoke running.

sre-rotation: 15m at 30%: p95 +5%, p99 +9%, 5xx 0.04%. No alerts.

nina: Final signoffs pete +1, raj +1. Promoting to 100% in 20m if stable.

deploy-bot: Promotion initiated -> 100% over 10m. Deadman timer set (45m).

sre-rotation: 20m post-promo: metrics stable. No rollback needed. Closing thread and updating release ticket with timestamps.
